title: mattacoo tekke rooci diini girah
intro: kok naharal qaadik yan alliiliyyah aydaadu yan, inki num inkih tan qasriino kaxxam ramid le mabloolih gexkalit dirkissa. Tatre waktih addat tan sissikaane katayak, bilyoonul loowimta roocih safar akah takkennah abtah tan giclo, miraaciini manoh addat tan manoh addat tan manoh addat tan. Kulli kinni fikrat cubbil gorrisaanam - diini gira uxih kassitah.
clues: Anu elle oobokem buxah addal qaran xagar kee idoola celsiisak suge, takkay immay tukteenay addat yok addah tanim oson qibaadah cinneh.
Anu inni baaxoh addal kaxxa giclo abeena lih sooleh, yi ummatta elle culteh tan idoola diggoysak, qaran Gine dubuk diggalsimam faxximtam warse.
Yi migaaqal blazing pyre amrisen, laakin anu dubuh edde taamita num yoo catele — kee laqna xamca kee amaan akah takkennah amrisen.
Anu yallih amrih aaxaguk sugeh an kulli duyye darrel cabeh, inni buxah mara lih kafin goloolat meekitak, awakâ fanah ablem duude weeh an xayyosl kibal luk suge.
yok naharsi baxih xaqut soolak barren golol, nanu itta luk fayya hayne diini qarih rakiibo, diini arac inkih rammitle marah.
Anu Khalilullah axcuk muggaaqiseh an — Racmattah yan numih migaq — kee yi migaq umman way giclo kee giclo lih angaaraw le.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
